title: Physical Intimacy: A Biblical Perspective
description: Chapter 8 summary and homework from Marriage Enrichment 2022

gospel_data.title: Physical Intimacy: A Biblical Perspective

subsections.title: Introduction
subsections.content:
Genesis 2:24 For this reason a man shall leave his father and his mother, and be joined to his wife; and they shall become one flesh.
A. The 'one flesh' relationship is broader than the sexual relationship, but it does include it.
B. The sexual relationship between a husband and wife is an area that can bring great pleasure and enhance a marriage, but it also is an area where problems commonly occur.
1 Corinthians 10:31 Whether, then, you eat or drink or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

nestedSubsections.title: Sex is for Married Couples Only!
nestedSubsections.content:
1. God designed sex as a wonderful gift for married couples. Sexual relations are to be freely enjoyed within the confines of the marriage covenant.

  2. Stuart Scott states, "Our country has been in a moral decline over the past fifty years which has drastically affected our culture."1

    1. Our society has ignored the boundaries of marriage and cohabitation is absolutely the norm. Premarital sex and adultery are so common that it almost doesn't even arouse a response.
      Hebrews 13:4 Marriage is to be held in honor among all, and the marriage bed is to be undefiled; for fornicators and adulterers God will judge. a. Fornication is a broad term that means any sexual immorality, but often refers to premarital sex.

    2. Douglas Wilson teaches, "One of the functions of marriage in a fallen world is to help guard against temptations to immortality" 1 Corinthians 7:23.2
      1 Corinthians 7:2-3 But because of immoralities, each man is to have his own wife, and each woman is to have her own husband. The husband must fulfill his duty to his wife, and likewise also the wife to her husband.

      1. Unless someone has been given the 'gift of celibacy,' they should pursue marriage.3
        1 Corinthians 7:9 But if they do not have self-control, let them marry; for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.

nestedSubsections.title: Sex within Marriage is Good.
nestedSubsections.content:
Genesis 1:31 God saw all that He had made, and behold, it was very good.

  1. Tim Garnder states, "Within the protective boundaries of the wife-husband relationship, sex brings incredible honor to God."4 Hebrews 13:4 Marriage is to be held in honor among all, and the marriage bed is to be undefiled . . .

  2. Martha Peace states, "An 'undefiled marriage bed' means the couple has sexual relations and neither one is unfaithful to the other, nor impure in their thoughts or actions."5

    1. She goes on to say, "A Wife having undefiled sex with her husband is in no way sinful or dirty. She should have a godly attitude realizing that physical intimacy with her husband is not an unholy or less holy act than praying or singing in the choir. As long as her thoughts and motives and actions are pure, she is pleasing to God and God views what she is doing as good."6

nestedSubsections.title: Pleasure is Assumed and is not Sinful.
nestedSubsections.content:
1. Some have viewed sex as something to 'put up with' and a necessary evil for procreation. These views are unbiblical.
    Proverbs 5:18-19 Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice in the wife of your youth. As a loving hind and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; Be exhilarated always with her love.
    Song of Solomon 7:10-12 I am my beloved's, And his desire is for me. Come, my beloved, let us go out into the country, Let us spend the night in the villages. Let us rise early and go to the vineyards; Let us see whether the vine has budded And its blossoms have opened, And whether the pomegranates have bloomed. There I will give you my love.

    1. Experiencing pleasure with physical intimacy within a marriage covenant is assumed in Scripture.

nestedSubsections.title: Sex is an Expression of Complete Oneness.
nestedSubsections.content:
Genesis 2:24 For this reason a man shall leave his father and his mother, and be joined to his wife; and they shall become one flesh.

  1. There is no place where the complete oneness of a husband and wife is more clearly and beautifully communicated and experienced than in their sexual relationship.

    1. Wayne Mack teaches, "Sexual intercourse is more than a physical act; it is a symbol of a spiritual relationship and the expression of the complete oneness of two persons in married love . . . It is . . . the means by which they are confirmed and nourished in that union."7

    2. Mack goes on to say, "The true dignity of sex is in its ability to enhance this personal unity between two persons who have committed themselves to each other in love and marriage. In sexual intercourse the couple becomes joined in an indissoluble unity, called in the Bible 'one flesh.'"8

nestedSubsections.title: Sex is to be Other-Focused.
nestedSubsections.content:
1. Biblical love is always 'giving.' It is always concerned about the needs and desires of the other person first and foremost.
    Acts 20:35 . . . remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that He Himself said, "It is more blessed to give than to receive."

  2. Problems occur when sex is self-focused.

    1. When a husband's desire for pleasure has become his main concern, and he lacks concern for his wife's desires, overtime, his wife will begin to feel like an object to be used rather than a person who is loved.

      1. This type of self-focus damages a marriage. Bitterness is on the horizon for a couple that has become self-focused.

  3. The goal in sex needs to be to please your spouse and give them pleasure.
    Philippians 2:3-4 Do nothing from selfishness or empty conceit, but with humility of mind regard one another as more important than yourselves; do not merely look out for your own personal interests, but also for the interests of others.

    1. If you have been self-focused, you need to confess this as sin against God and against your spouse. Then, repent of this sinful behavior, 'putting off' your self-focused attitude and behavior and 'putting on' an other-focused attitude.

    2. You may need to study your spouse and learn what preferences they have. This will require each of you to be vulnerably open in your communication with each other.
      1 Peter 3:7 You husbands in the same way, live with your wives in an understanding way, as with someone weaker, since she is a woman; and show her honor as a fellow heir of the grace of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
      1 Corinthians 7:3 The husband must fulfill his duty to his wife, and likewise also the wife to her husband.

  4. Married couples must not be self-focused; rather they must be other-focused. They must both have an attitude of serving the other and giving their spouse pleasure.

nestedSubsections.title: Sex is to be Regular and Continuous.
nestedSubsections.content:
1. There is no set number of times per week in the Bible for a married couple to engage in sex, but there is a principle.

    1. It should be often enough that neither spouse is experiencing frustration or temptation.
      Proverbs 5:19 As a loving hind and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; Be exhilarated always with her love.

    2. Married couples should engage in sexual relations often enough to be satiated and not frustrated.

      1. Warning: Couples can get into the habit of not having sex, or not engaging in it very often. When this happens, they are living together more like a brother and sister than a husband and wife!
        1 Corinthians 7:5 Stop depriving one another, except by agreement for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer, and come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

        1. When a couple is not engaging in regular and continuous sexual relations, they are setting themselves up for disaster, as temptations will almost surely occur!
          1 Corinthians 7:3-4 The husband must fulfill this duty to his wife, and likewise also the wife to her husband. The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does; and likewise also the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

      2. If there is a lack of interest in physical intimacy, there is almost certainly an underlying problem that needs to be addressed.

        1. Couples that have physical conditions and other health problems can almost always still satisfy each other sexually. Unless you are truly physically unable to have sexual relations because of a legitimate disability, the Bible says the 'two shall become one flesh.'

nestedSubsections.title: Sexual Relations are to be Equally Initiated and Reciprocal.
nestedSubsections.content:
1. The popular notion that the husband must be the initiator of sexual relations is unbiblical and harmful. Both the husband and wife should be initiating sex regularly.
    1 Corinthians 7:3-4 The husband must fulfill this duty to his wife, and likewise also the wife to her husband. The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does; and likewise also the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

    1. Merely submitting to sexual relations without showing passion or interest is nearly equivalent to rejection.

nestedSubsections.title: What if I have no interest in sex?
nestedSubsections.content:
1. See your medical provider and get an examination to see if there is a physical or organic issue.

    1. Christians do not have the option of having a mediocre marriage if they would be pleasing to God. If there is a problem, get biblical help to resolve it quickly.

nestedSubsections.title: What if I don't feel like having sex because things aren't right between us?
nestedSubsections.content:
1. Jay Adams teaches, "Love is not feeling first. Before all else it is the determination to do good for another person because God has told you to do so. Love begins, therefore, with a desire to please God. Love toward another is a willingness to give to him whatever you have that he needs, because you know that God wants you to. Where true love exists, the feeling follows soon enough."9

  2. If the sexual relationship is suffering couples should look closely at other areas in their marriage and see if they have been hurting or neglecting each other.

  3. Warning: There is a danger in using the sexual relationship as a barometer for your marriage. While it is often true that a lack of sex is an indicator of problems in other areas, it is just as true that a lack of intimacy can cause problems in other areas.

nestedSubsections.title: Can pornography enhance sex?
nestedSubsections.content:
1. Pornography is inherently sinful and self-focused.
    Matthew 5:28 but I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman with lust for her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

nestedSubsections.title: What is permissible in sex?
nestedSubsections.content:
1. Anything is permissible if it is mutually agreeable, pleasurable, not offensive to your partner, not harmful, and not sinful.

    1. If something violates your conscience, you should refrain from doing it until you are sure it is not sinful.
      Romans 14:23 . . . whatever is not from faith is sin.

nestedSubsections.title: What if I am not sure how to give my partner pleasure?
nestedSubsections.content:
1. Open, honest, and vulnerable communication within a marriage covenant is important, especially when discussing a sensitive or intimate topic.
    Genesis 2:25 And the man and his wife were both naked and were not ashamed.

subsections.title: Conclusion
subsections.content:
1. I. It is vitally important that you fulfill the mandate of your office within your marriage. This includes the areas of physical intimacy.
    1 Corinthians 7:5 Stop depriving one another, except by agreement for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer, and come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

  1. Stuart Scott, The Exemplary Husband: A Biblical Perspective, 144.

  2. Douglas Wilson, My Life for Your Life: A Walk through the Christian Home, 75.

  3. Jay Adams, Marriage, Divorce, and Remarriage, 9.

  4. Tim Alan Gardner, Sacred Sex: A Spiritual Celebration of Oneness in Marriage, 34.

  5. Martha Peace, The Excellent Wife: A Biblical Perspective, 123.

  6. Martha Peace, The Excellent Wife: A Biblical Perspective, 123.

  7. Wayne Mack, Strengthening Your Marriage, 120.

  8. Wayne Mack, Strengthening Your Marriage, 120.

  9. Jay E. Adams, What Do You Do When Your Marriage Goes Sour?, 1-2.

subsections.title: Homework Questions
subsections.content: Complete the exercises below and save your answers.

questions.question:
Memory Verse:

1 Corinthians 7:4-5 The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does; and likewise also the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does. Stop depriving one another, except by agreement for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer, and come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

Scripture: Read 1 Corinthians 7:1-5 with each other.
Discuss with your spouse what it means to "Stop depriving one another, except by agreement for a time."
Read Proverbs 5:18-19 together.
Discuss what it means to be "Satisfied at all times."
Review and discuss this lesson with your spouse.
Pray daily for God's help to love and serve one another faithfully and continuously in your sexual relationship. Pray that you would not be self-focused but other focused.
Application - If you have been self-focused in your sex life, confess this sin to your spouse and to God. Ask for forgiveness.
